description: 尼姆佐印度E32 — 关键时机：Bxc3交换时机的判断

intro.popup_en:
Key Timing, Demo 3: Nimzo-Indian
Black can often exchange on c3 with ...Bxc3, but when is it most valuable? This game studies the timing of ...Bxc3+ after a3 and the structural consequences that follow.
intro.popup:
关键时机演示3

尼姆佐印度防御！

黑方象几乎随时可以Bxc3
但何时交换最有价值？

练习目标：
理解5...Bxc3+的时机意义

outro.popup_en: Three key decisions: exchange with ...Bxc3+ after a3 to force a queen recapture and create doubled pawns; use ...c5 to attack the weakened center; then play ...e5 and ...d5 when the timing is right. The value of an exchange depends on when it is made.
outro.popup:
尼姆佐时机总结

三个关键判断：
① a3时Bxc3+：迫使后接，产生双重兵
② c5：利用双重兵向中心反击
③ e5+d5：时机成熟，中心突破

时机不同，价值截然不同！

moves.popup:
Bb4！尼姆佐！
钉住白方c3马
moves.popup_en: ...Bb4! The Nimzo-Indian bishop pins White's knight on c3.
Qc2 avoids doubled c-pawns if Black exchanges on c3.
a3 asks Black to decide what to do with the bishop.

moves.popup:
Bxc3+！时机！
迫使后接，产生双重兵
moves.popup_en: ...Bxc3+! The timing is right: the exchange forces a queen recapture and creates doubled c-pawns.
Qxc3 is forced to recapture with the queen.
...b6 prepares to develop the bishop to b7.
Bg5 adds pressure to Black's position.

moves.popup:
c5！利用双重兵软肋
向中心反击
moves.popup_en: ...c5! Black uses White's doubled-pawn structure as a target and counterattacks in the center.
...Rc8 activates Black's rook on the c-file.
...Re8 places a rook on the e-file.

moves.popup:
d5！时机成熟
白方中心推进
moves.popup_en: d5! White advances when the timing is right and the central opportunity has matured.
